A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AREA3D and contain readable main text and five-page supplementary material. Methods, equations, tables and visualizations can be matched reliably despite renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: V1 reports original reconstruction experiments on Replica and OmniObject3D, including baseline comparisons, component ablations and supplementary global-initial-weight experiments.

after.justification: V2 retains those original reconstruction experiments and ablations, and adds measured wall-clock runtimes in Table 5.

M1.justification: The reported VGGT/VLM dual-field method, visibility masks, greedy selection and uncertainty decay remain unchanged. Sentences explaining utility bounds and non-maximum suppression are shortened, but these operations remain in Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use four Replica rooms and four OmniObject3D tabletop configurations: single-object, five-object and two seven-object arrangements. The runtime sweeps vary computational settings without adding datasets, domains or tasks.

E2.justification: Corresponding tables and figures retain their comparator sets, including FisherRF for scene-level reconstruction and AIR-Embodied for object-level reconstruction. Newly cited related works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: New Table 5 introduces runtime evaluation across view budgets T=5-40 at voxel size 0.5, and voxel sizes 0.5-0.2 at fixed F=25. Existing reconstruction budgets, PGSR representation and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS evaluation remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 adds a computational scalability analysis testing runtime sensitivity to view budget and voxel resolution. The component ablation, global-initial-weight ablation and qualitative comparisons are retained, including v1 Table 7 becoming v2 Table 8.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental repeat counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The added runtime measurements also use point values without statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Existing reconstruction scores, plotted trends and supplementary ablation values are unchanged. Table 5 adds runtimes increasing from 134.9 to 139.2 seconds across T=5-40 at voxel size 0.5, and from 138 to 207 seconds as voxel size decreases from 0.5 to 0.2 at F=25.

T1.justification: The budgeted selection formulation, back-projection, confidence objective, semantic modulation, frustum decay and additive uncertainty equations are mathematically unchanged. No new assumptions, derivations or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the same main contributions: dual-field feed-forward/VLM planning, a unified object/scene benchmark, and strong reconstruction accuracy and efficiency under sparse-view budgets. The revised conclusion reiterates the existing view-efficiency claim.

C2.justification: V2 removes the blanket all-settings superiority statement and the unqualified component-removal performance-drop explanation. The retained Table 3 still shows single-object PSNR of 32.15 for Uniform versus 31.59 for AREA3D. New discussion interprets runtime scaling and attributes increased cost at finer voxel resolutions to spatial discretization.

D1.justification: V2 removes the promised-code sentence and repository address from v1's abstract. It adds voxel-size settings and total execution times for the scalability study. Supplementary prompts, coefficients and decay parameters remain unchanged; actual code availability cannot be established from these PDFs.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations to GLEAM, NextBestPath and Move to Understand a 3D Scene within existing related-work discussions. The overall positioning relative to geometric, neural-field and VLM planning approaches remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract and several related-work, method, baseline and results passages receive limited rewriting or shortening. Acknowledgements gain funding information and become Section 6, shifting supplementary section numbers. The overall narrative and organization remain intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds the two-part runtime Table 5, adjusts table formatting and page flow, and corrects Figure 5's caption from a PSNR-versus-frames description to novel-view synthesis results. Existing plots and qualitative comparisons are retained; supplementary tables are renumbered.

improvement.justification: V2 supplies previously absent computational scaling measurements, softens overly broad performance interpretations and corrects Figure 5's misleading caption. These improve support and clarity, although the timings lack hardware and repeated-run details, and the promised-code link is lost. With the method and reconstruction evidence unchanged, the net improvement is limited.
